Forward, not back to the default.
The
refinement did hear the announcement and
only its onset overshot backwards; VAD then
says where the speech after the overshot
pause begins, which is the announcement's
own first word. A default-mode position has
nothing behind it but the framing of
whichever window the pass happened to open.
Never past the default, though: the walk
goes backwards from it, so an announcement
it overshot lies between the two. A
resumption beyond the default means the
guard was handed geometry it cannot read.

The finding window's own figure is the worst-
framed look the run takes at an announcement -
its segment routinely swallows the jingle - so
it is kept only where the refinement confirmed
nothing. Not the best of the readings either:
that would make a mark look more certain the
more probes the search needed.
